reason: Alpha.6 PR-I2 (Lane 2) ships the CONSUMER half of the timed-wake contract while its carrier stays CORE_SEAM_BLOCKER: one production module `timed-wake/decision.ts` (`decideTimedWake(deps, request)` and `observeTimedWake(deps, inner)`, with the `TimedWakePort`/`TimedWakeFact`/`TimedWakeRefusal` types of memo `docs/plans/memo/alpha6-timed-wake/timedwake-port-contract-20261031.md` §2-§3) plus its barrel `index.ts` and its spec `a6-pr-i2-timed-wake.test.ts`. Everything injectable is injected — an optional port, a wall clock, a durable-fact sink, an idempotency lookup — so the module holds NO timer, NO scheduler, NO storage handle and NO host import: §6 and ruling 一 of 2026-10-31 forbid a second timer family in the plugin, so a wake guarantee either comes from the host or is refused. The shipping behaviour is therefore the refusal surface: no port (every case in this phase) answers `{accepted:false, code:'TIMED_WAKE_UNAVAILABLE'}` and appends a `timed-wake-refused` fact, never `accepted:true` under any input shape; a carrier's own refusal travels through as `PORT_REFUSED` with its `portCode` verbatim, unrewritten; a past `notBefore` means immediate unless the caller asks for the strict reading; a carrier EXCEPTION is recorded as `timed-wake-schedule-error` and rethrown rather than laundered into a refusal code; a delivery is recorded before the business effect runs, and a throwing handler records `timed-wake-fire-error` without erasing the fact that the moment arrived. Durable facts are a closed five-member union with no authority, identity, permission or decision field, and the spec screens every recorded key against the PR-I1a authority pattern. THIRTEEN legs, all over fakes: memo §4 legs 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 bound the consumer; legs 2 and 5 are exercised against a fake oracle (replay keeps `dueSinceEpochMs` and sets `replay:true`; a rolled-back clock delivers twice rather than dropping) and are re-runnable against a real adapter — they do NOT show that any host persists a wake, and nothing in this PR claims it. ZERO wiring: `src/plugin/host.ts` is untouched, `inject` unchanged, because memo §10 gates wiring on legs L-1a/L-1b having been measured against a real host, and this machine has no `tests/deepseek-harness-test-use` and no `tests/homes` — ENV-REFUSED, recorded as refused, not as a pass. Also edited, in already-counted files: `packages/runtime/tsconfig.build.json` gains the `timed-wake` include entry (the compile face that emits the module's dist mirror; dist is outside this scan but co-committed under the install-surface law). Zero protected-centre files touched — `control/`, `operation-permission/`, `tool-admission/`, `tool-dispatch/`, `governance-center/` and both `src/plugin/live/*` protected paths are untouched. Zero new denylist vocabulary.
tieNote: WHAT THIS BOOKING MACHINE-ENFORCES, so nothing is read into it that the gate does not check: the path SET (a new scannable file under packages/** that is not booked, or a booked path that vanishes, fails the leg) and the from/to delta arithmetic. The leg count in `reason` is DESCRIPTIVE PROSE about the delivery, not a value the census reads. MEASURED on this tree, not copied from a chain: with these three files present and this entry absent, `p4t6-session-event-scan` fails four legs whose arithmetic detail is the verbatim `expected 1416 to be 1419` (tracked evidence `dev/agent-workflow/evidence/alpha6-pri-i2/p4t6-RED-unbooked.txt`, captured in this same commit — a durable record points at a durable file, never at gitignored scratch — the same run also shows `control: an UNBOOKED new path on disk turns the exact total RED`, `a path booked TWICE`, and `a tie that no longer matches its list is RED`, i.e. the sensitivity controls are live and this entry is what makes the total leg pass again). 1419 - 1416 = 3 = the paths booked here, and 1416 is the value `alpha6-pr2.json` ends this branch's chain at. Files a reader may look for and not find: `packages/runtime/dist/packages/runtime/timed-wake/{decision,index}.{js,d.ts,js.map,d.ts.map}` is NOT counted (the scanner does not descend into dist) but is co-committed because adding a module to the compile face changes that face's emitted bytes. THIS PR is stacked on PR #507's head, so its base is not master and hosted CI runs no suites on it — which is why every leg above was executed locally at the head SHA and why the settlement gate answers BLOCKED-BY-MARKER while the DO-NOT-MERGE marker stands.
